title: How Many Minutes of Exercise Should a 70-Year-Old Do Each Week?
description: CDC recommends 150 minutes — but 72% of adults 70+ do less than half; discover what really works for you
primaryKeyword: how many minutes exercise 70 year old
perplexityQuestions: What is the best exercise routine for seniors who have never worked out before?
How many minutes of exercise should a 70-year-old do each week?
What is the safest way for a 68-year-old to start exercising after years of inactivity?
Can seniors do strength training every day, or how many days a week is safe?
What exercises are best for older adults who get short of breath quickly?
competitorCoverage: Top-ranking articles on exercise for seniors usually cover the same core framework: aerobic activity, strength training, balance, and flexibility, plus the standard weekly targets of 150 minutes of moderate activity, 2 days of muscle strengthening, and regular balance work.[1][2][5][7] They also emphasize starting slowly, warming up and cooling down, choosing low-impact or home-friendly options, and checking with a clinician if the person has chronic conditions, dizziness, fall risk, or recent injury.[4][6][7] To compete, a new article should clearly explain how to begin safely, how to progress week by week, what to do for common barriers like fear of falling or low stamina, and how to adapt the routine for very inactive beginners.
